title: A SYNC.md §8 test vector
description: Language-neutral script run by every sync implementation (Python, Kotlin, Swift, the Dock360 edition). Time is simulated: 'start' is true time; each controller and store sees true time plus its skew (skewMs, or 'clock' for an absolute start). Controllers are reference controllers with users {name: {password, transmit}}; stores are local stores of one app. runner 'script' runs steps then checks expect; 'unreachable' (T14: adding a QSO while the controller swallows packets returns within budgetMs) and 'processes' (T18: processes writers each add perProcess QSOs to one store; none lost, stamps unique, one sync lease holder) need runner code of their own.

step.description: tick: advance true time by ms; every party's clock moves with it; skew: set a party's clock to true time + ms; resetOffset also zeroes the store's measured clock offset (an error it could not measure); add: store adds a logbook record id with fields (idFromPage: the runner mints prefix + page counter); addMany: store adds count records in one transaction, ids idPrefix + 12-digit index, call T<i>; update: store edits fields of id (fieldsFromPage: set that field to 'page <n>'); delete: store deletes id; profile: store updates its station profile with set; pair: store pairs with controller as user/password (defaults brian/pw); expect paired|needsDecision; pageLimit and duringEachPage (steps run after every pull page of the pairing's sync) are optional; resolve: store answers the last NeedsDecision with choice merge|use-controller; unpair: store unpairs; sync: store runs one sync round; expectState (default idle) is the status state afterwards; fromSeq 0 drops the cursor first; dropNextPushAnswer: controller applies the next push and loses the answer; offline: controller stops (value true) or starts answering; backup: controller snapshots its services database as name; restore: controller restores snapshot name (new epoch); inject: controller receives record as if pushed by another store; markRequests: remember the store's request count for a later requests expectation

expectation.description: record: in each of where, record id of collection exists, live as given, fields include the given values, envelope keys in extra present; count: in each of where, the number of live records equals live; countAtLeast: as count, at least; converged: every party in where holds the same records with the same fields, stamps and tombstones; history: the controller's history of id has edits entries, the union of their lost fields equals lostFields, their kinds equal kinds; status: the store's sync status has these values; noFutureHlc: no stamp on the controller is more than 10 minutes ahead of its clock; hlcAtLeastFloor: every stamp on the party is at or above the library's clock floor; archive: the store archived station-*.db and station-*.adi beside itself; requests: the store made sinceMark requests since markRequests; profile: each store's profile contains has (nested subset)
